note: *** Co-founder of the Argentine Stud Book; a Group 1 at Palermo renamed for him in 1914. A Lerena at the centre of Argentine thoroughbred breeding, in the right country at the right time - and PABLO ARMANDO TRAINED AND OWNED RACEHORSES. *** Born Montevideo 24 May 1855, died 8 December 1912. His father is now documented rather than asserted: his brother Luis Eugenio's marriage act of 19 December 1864 names their parents as Don Luis and Dona Justiniana Lenguas. That he and Luis Eugenio are BROTHERS still rests on published genealogy, not on an act, and is marked secondary on the charts. *** NO PROVEN LINK TO PABLO ARMANDO. *** *** HIS PARENTS ARE NOW NAMED, 13 September 2026: LUIS LERENA and JUSTINIANA LENGUAS. *** Two independent Uruguayan parish records, entered for two different children of his, both give his parents so. That makes him A BROTHER OF LUIS EUGENIO LERENA LENGUAS - the same Montevideo household that produced the one Lerena baptism in Rosario before 1879. The racing dynasty and the Rosario thread are the same family. *** THE IMAGE IS NOW OPENED, AND IT IS PRIMARY. *** Act 1447 of 31 October 1886 baptises his daughter Maria Angelica Julia, "hija legitima de Don Gilberto Lerena y de Dona Julia Salvanach, orientales", and names the paternal grandparents "Don LUIS y Dona JUSTINIANA LENGUAS" - the same couple named as Luis Eugenio's parents in his marriage act of 1864 and his death act of 1901. *** AND THE GODMOTHER IS DONA JULIA JUANICO DE LERENA - Luis Eugenio's own wife, standing at the font for her husband's brother's daughter. *** The two households are one family acting as one. Written by Martin Perez, the same priest who wrote act 1720 for Candido Jaime that year. *** AND A SECOND ACT, FROM A DIFFERENT PARISH, SAYS THE SAME, 14 September 2026: *** the baptism of his son Raul Alfredo Luis at the Catedral Basilica on 10 September 1885 gives "abuelos paternos: Luis y Justiniana Lenguas" and "abuelos maternos: Cristobal y Angela Alvarez" - identical to act 1447, in a different year, a different parish and a different priest's hand. note: *** The only LERENA baptised at Rosario between 1731 and 1901 - and now followed to the end of the story. *** Born 8 October 1865, baptised at Rosario 17 February 1866 to Don Luis Lerena Lenguas and Dona Julia Juanico, "naturales del E. Oriental". On 3 November 1886, aged 21, she married Don Jaime Herrera at San Francisco de Asis, Ciudad Vieja, MONTEVIDEO - the act naming her parents again, in a second country, twenty years later. She went home. *** NOT the Maria Lerena who was Pablo Armando's mother: that woman had a son in February 1882, when this one was sixteen and four years from marrying someone else. ***

name: Don Luis Eugenio LERENA LENGUAS
source: Montevideo civil death registration No. 216, 24 December 1901 - IMAGE READ; plus Rosario baptism act 1541 (1866) and Montevideo marriage act 258 (1864); and his own baptism, La Mauricia, Villa de la Union, 7 Jan 1846 - IMAGE READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZS62-J
note: *** DOCUMENTED, 13 September 2026. *** "Natural de esta Republica", married Dona Julia Juanico at San Francisco de Asis, Ciudad Vieja, Montevideo, on 19 December 1864 - act 258, image read - which names him "hijo legitimo de Don Luis y de Dona Justiniana Lenguas". His daughter Laura Adela's baptism of 1869 names the same two as her paternal grandparents, independently. So his parentage is PRIMARY, not the tree assertion it was that morning; and it makes him a brother of GILBERTO JUSTINIANO LERENA LENGUAS, co-founder of the Argentine Stud Book - though THAT brotherhood still rests on published genealogy rather than an act, and is marked secondary on the chart. Five children, all on primary records. Died before 11 July 1910, when his widow's death was registered. *** NO LINK TO JUAN CARLOS LERENA HAS BEEN SHOWN. *** *** HIS DEATH IS FOUND: 24 DECEMBER 1901, at seven in the morning, at the house calle Suarez No. 25 in el Paso del Molino, Montevideo. *** Act 216. "De nacionalidad oriental, nacido en Montevideo, de cincuenta y seis [anos], de estado casado, y de profesion HACENDADO" - a landowner, which is the first statement of this family's standing anywhere in the archive. He died of pulmonary tuberculosis, certified by Dr Scremini. *** IT WAS HIDING UNDER A MISSPELLING: *** FamilySearch indexes him as Luis SERENA Lenguas, so every search under LERENA missed him, including a 1,502-row sweep of Montevideo Lerena deaths run the same morning. He was found by searching for his MOTHER. The act also says his father Luis Lerena was already dead, and that his mother Justiniana Lenguas was ALIVE AT 79 and staying in the same house. *** HIS OWN BAPTISM IS NOW READ: born 9 FEBRUARY 1843, baptised 7 January 1846 at the Capilla de la Mauricia, Villa de la Union. *** "Hijo legitimo de Luis Lerena y Justiniana Lenguas, ORIENTALES. Paternos: Francisco y Maria Fernandez. Maternos: Pedro y Carmen Gonzalez." Godparents Juan Lenguas and Maria Fernandez. His death act of 1901 gave his age as 56, implying 1845; the act of his own baptism is the better evidence.

name: Dona Julia JUANICO
source: Montevideo civil death registration no. 357, 12 July 1910 - image read; plus Rosario baptism act 1541 (1866) and Montevideo marriage act 258 (1864); baptism act No. 405, folio 274, 4 Oct 1843 - IMAGE READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NLLP
note: Daughter of Dr Candido Juanico and Dona Juliana Gonzalez. Married Luis Eugenio Lerena Lenguas at San Francisco de Asis, Montevideo, 19 December 1864. *** DIED 11 JULY 1910 at calle Constituyente 992, Montevideo, aged sixty-six, A WIDOW *** - which dates her husband's death to before that. *** HER BAPTISM IS FOUND AND THE IMAGE READ: born 23 November 1842 at Montevideo, christened 4 October 1843 at San Francisco de Asis *** - the same parish where she married in 1864, where her son Candido Jaime was baptised in 1886, and where her daughter Maria married that November. Her mother is given in full as JULIANA JOAQUINA GONZALEZ; godparents D. Enrique Juanico and Mercedes Gonzalez. Her death registration estimated 1844 from a stated age of 66; she was 67.

name: Don Luis LERENA (the godfather) = probably Luis LERENA y Fernandez
source: Named as godfather in Rosario baptism act 1541 (1866), represented by proxy
note: Stood godfather at Rosario in 1866 but did not attend - represented by Don Claudino Campos, which is what one does from the other side of the river. *** THAT HE IS THE CHILD'S GRANDFATHER IS NOW DOCUMENTED, NOT INFERRED: *** the Montevideo marriage act of 19 December 1864 names the groom "hijo legitimo de Don Luis y de Dona Justiniana Lenguas", and Laura Adela's baptism of 1869 names "abuelos paternos Don Luis y Dona Justiniana Lenguas" - two acts, independently. What remains SECONDARY is only the equation with LUIS LERENA y FERNANDEZ (1811-1878) of the published trees, and through him the line up to Sancho. The 1866 child's fifth given name is JUSTINIANA, for that grandmother. *** AND HIS OWN PARENTS ARE NOW IN AN ACT: "Paternos: D. Sancho y Dona Maria Fernandez", from his son Alberto Octavio's baptism of 7 October 1850. *** The "y Fernandez" of the published trees is his mother's name, and it is correct. Two 1846 transcripts give the father as FRANCISCO instead; they are copies, and the 1850 original is preferred.

name: Armando LERENA
source: Uruguay, Passenger Lists 1888-1980; index ark 1:1:QPWH-BN11, image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS73-G9MX-6
note: *** THE ONLY OTHER ARMANDO LERENA FOUND ANYWHERE IN THE RIVER PLATE. *** Entry 28 on a Buenos Aires - Montevideo crossing, January/February 1910: aged 26, married, and the clerk wrote his nationality in the manifest itself as "Oriental" - Uruguayan. Read from the image, not the index. NOT Pablo Armando on the evidence: wrong nationality, two years out on the age, and in 1910 Pablo Armando was at the Cape and did not marry until September 1911. But an Armando Lerena of almost exactly his age, Uruguayan, is the shape a brother or a cousin would have.

source: Montevideo civil death registration no. 46, 17 May 1914

name: Ema Sixta LERENA Juanico
source: La Union marriage register act 90, 30 June 1913 - image read
note: *** Married JOSE PEDRO MASSERA (1866-1942), professor of philosophy at the Universidad de la Republica and later a Colorado senator; their son was the mathematician Jose Luis Massera. *** The witnesses at her wedding were her sister Maria and her brother-in-law Jaime Herrera - the couple of the 1886 act. Aged thirty-three on the act, so born about 1880; a findmypast index says 1876. She is the "Emma Liseta, 1876, father Luis, mother Julia" copied from a findmypast index on 9 September, four days before the family was identified. Named SIXTA for Sixta Lenguas Gonzalez, her mother's stepmother. *** HER BIRTH DATE IS NOW SETTLED AT 21 NOVEMBER 1876, not c.1880. *** Three independent records agree: the civil birth registration of 30 May 1903, the Uruguay Baptisms index, and her christening at the Catedral on 8 January 1881. The c.1880 came from her stated age at marriage in 1913, and ages at marriage are the weakest date in genealogy.

name: Dr. Don Candido JUANICO
source: Named as the bride's father and as a witness, Montevideo marriage act 258 (1864); and his second wife's death act, Montevideo No. 45 of 17 Jan 1884 - IMAGE READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-N36Y-D
note: Father of Julia Juanico. Son of Francisco Juanico and Juliana Texeira. Stood as witness at his daughter's wedding in December 1864. *** HE MARRIED TWICE. *** Juliana Joaquina Gonzalez first - Julia, b.1842, is hers - and SIXTA LENGUAS second, by whom Sara, Zara Sista Emirena and Celia Juanico Lenguas, born 1866-1869. Note the second wife's surname: his daughter by the first married a Lerena LENGUAS. Justiniana Lenguas and Sixta Lenguas are very likely kin, which would mean these two families were already connected before 1864 - recorded as an observation, not a proved relationship. *** HIS AGE AND PROFESSION ARE NOW ON AN ACT: *** Sixta's death registration of 17 January 1884 records her husband as "D. Candido Juanico, Oriental, edad 72 anos, viudo, ABOGADO" - so born about 1812, and a lawyer, which is what this archive's "Dr." has always rested on.

name: Dona Juliana Joaquina GONZALEZ
source: Named as the bride's mother, Montevideo marriage act 258 (1864); and again as maternal grandmother in Montevideo baptism act 1720 (1886) - image read; and act No. 405 of 4 Oct 1843, her daughter's own baptism - IMAGE READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-NLLP; and act No. 1720 of 1886, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-Z9RS-F
note: Mother of Julia Juanico, and wife of Dr Candido Juanico. Published genealogy gives Candido's wife as SIXTA Lenguas Gonzalez, married 1857 - too late for a daughter marrying in 1864, so Juliana is an earlier wife. That is inference from dates. *** A THIRD ACT NOW NAMES HER, 13 September 2026: *** the baptism of her grandson Candido Jaime, San Francisco de Asis act No. 1720 of 6 July 1886, reads "maternos: Don Candido y Dona Juliana Gonzalez". Twenty-two years after the marriage act, the same parish still gives Julia's mother as Juliana Gonzalez. The published genealogy's SIXTA Lenguas Gonzalez is not what the registers say. *** AND THE TWO-WIVES INFERENCE IS CONFIRMED. *** Searching Candido Juanico as a father returns two distinct sets of children: Julia, by Juliana Joaquina Gonzalez, born 1842; and Sara, Zara Sista Emirena and Celia, all JUANICO LENGUAS, born 1866-1869 to SIXTA LENGUAS. A full generation apart. The published genealogy was right about the 1857 marriage and wrong to attach it to Julia.

name: Dona Justiniana LENGUAS Gonzalez
source: Named as the groom's mother, and a witness, in Montevideo marriage act 258 (1864)
note: Mother of the LERENA LENGUAS, and named as such in TWO acts read here: her son Luis Eugenio's marriage of 19 December 1864, at which she was also a witness, and her granddaughter Laura Adela's baptism of 1869, which calls her one of the "abuelos paternos". Her sister SIXTA LENGUAS GONZALEZ married Dr Candido Juanico - so the Lenguas married into both houses, and Sixta stood godmother to Laura Adela in 1869. That she was the second wife of Luis Lerena y Fernandez, and a daughter of Gen. Pedro Lenguas Grandal, is SECONDARY. *** SHE WAS ALIVE ON 24 DECEMBER 1901, AGED 79, and in the house where her son died. *** His death act No. 216 records her "de setenta y nueve anos, de profesion labores, domiciliada accidentalmente en la calle Suarez No. 25" - which puts her birth about 1822 and has her outliving Luis Eugenio. *** AND BY 1908 SHE WAS LIVING IN ARGENTINA, AGED 87. *** Her grandson Jose Julio's birth registration of that year describes her "de ochenta y siete anos, oriental, viuda, labores, RESIDENTE EN LA REPUBLICA ARGENTINA". She was 79 and in Montevideo when her son died in 1901; seven years later the matriarch of this family had crossed the river - and her son GILBERTO had moved to Buenos Aires between 1887 and 1889. *** HER OWN PARENTS ARE NOW IN AN ACT: "Maternos: el GENERAL D. PEDRO LENGUAS y Carmen Gonzalez". *** And that settles a question this archive had never been able to answer: SIXTA LENGUAS, the second wife of Dr Candido Juanico, has the very same parents on her 1884 death registration - so *** JUSTINIANA AND SIXTA ARE SISTERS. *** When Luis Eugenio married Julia Juanico in December 1864, the groom's maternal AUNT was already the bride's STEPMOTHER. The families had been joined since 1857.

name: Sancho LLERENA Aguilar
birthplace: Andalusia, Spain (the census says "Andaluzia"; CORDOBA comes only from a tree)
source: URUGUAY CENSUS 1726-1858, household 59 - image read; plus six indexed Uruguayan church and civil records; and NAMED IN AN ACT: the baptism of his grandson Alberto Octavio Lerena, 7 Oct 1850, S. Agustin, pueblo de la Restauracion - IMAGE READ, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-ZSZQ-J
note: *** NOW PARTLY PRIMARY. *** The Uruguayan census records him at Calle San Juan, Montevideo, aged 45, birthplace "ANDALUZIA", with MARIA FERNANDEZ on the line below - image opened and read. Six further indexed records name the same wife and the same children while spelling him LLERENA, LERENA, SANCIO LLERENA, D. SANCHO LERENA and LORENA. So the alternation is in the RECORDS, not in a tree. That they are all one man is still an inference, and Cordoba specifically still rests on the tree alone. *** ORIGINALLY RECORDED AS SECONDARY. *** The founder of the Montevideo Lerenas on the tree's account: a soldier from Cordoba who married Maria Josefa Fernandez Tresguerras at Canelones, 8 January 1791. His name is spelled BOTH Lerena and Llerena across forty years of Uruguayan registers, and once - in 1828 - "Sancho de Llerena". The acts have NOT been opened here. *** HE IS NOW ON AN ACT, 13 September 2026, and no longer only on an index and a published tree. *** Act 585 of 7 October 1850 names the paternal grandparents of Alberto Octavio Lerena as "D. SANCHO y Dona MARIA FERNANDEZ" - so Sancho really is the father of Don Luis Lerena, and the descent this archive marked SECONDARY is upgraded. A DISCREPANCY RECORDED AGAINST IT: two 1846 acts for other children of the same couple give the paternal grandfather as FRANCISCO, not Sancho. Those 1846 entries are LATER TRANSCRIPTS copied out of a legajo ("asi consta del Legajo conservado en este Archivo, mandado trasladar por el Sr. Obispo"), while the 1850 act is a contemporaneous parish entry - so the copy loses to the original. Everything else in both sets agrees.

name: Laura Adela LERENA Juanico
source: Iglesia Matriz de Montevideo, Libro 34 de Bautismos folio 271, bapt. 3 Mar 1869; civil transcription of 1902 read at image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-XSMB-7
note: *** A FIFTH CHILD of Luis Eugenio Lerena Lenguas and Julia Juanico, unknown to this archive until 13 September 2026. *** Born 27 June 1868, baptised 3 March 1869. Her baptism is the best record in the Montevideo file: it names BOTH SETS OF GRANDPARENTS - Don Luis and Dona Justiniana Lenguas; Don Candido and Dona Juliana Gonzalez - and her godparents were Don Candido Juanico and Dona Sixta Lenguas.

name: Jose Julio LERENA Juanico
source: Montevideo civil birth registration No. 283 of 1908 - IMAGE READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-W97S-F
note: *** A SIXTH CHILD of Luis Eugenio Lerena Lenguas and Julia Juanico, found 13 September 2026. *** Born 15 March 1879 at Montevideo and not registered until 14 September 1908, when he was 29 - a late registration of the kind a man makes to produce proof of birth for his own wedding, and he does appear on a Montevideo marriage index card for 1908. *** THE IMAGE IS OPENED. *** Born at the house calle YI No. 303, and registered in 1908 by HIS OWN MOTHER - Dona Julia Juanico, 64, a widow of calle Buenos Aires 102. The act independently confirms Luis Eugenio's death, "fallecido en esta Ciudad el veinte y cuatro de Diciembre de mil novecientos uno", from a different document written seven years after it. *** AND IT PLACES JUSTINIANA LENGUAS, AT EIGHTY-SEVEN, RESIDENT IN THE ARGENTINE REPUBLIC. ***

name: Candido Jaime LERENA Juanico
source: San Francisco de Asis, Ciudad Vieja, Montevideo, baptism act No. 1720, 6 July 1886 - IMAGE READ; image ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-Z9RS-F
note: *** A SEVENTH CHILD, and the best-documented of them all. *** Baptised 6 July 1886 at 21 months: "hijo legitimo de Don Luis Lerena Lenguas y de Dona Julia Juanico, orientales". The act names FOUR grandparents - paternal Don Luis and Dona Justiniana Lenguas, maternal Don Candido and Dona Juliana Gonzalez - and his godparents are his own eldest sister Maria Lerena and Don Jaime Herrera, whom she married in this same parish four months later. Named for his maternal grandfather and his godfather. The FamilySearch index of this act was made by a computer and garbled both parents into mothers; the image settles it. *** HE MARRIED MARIA CONCEPCION MAGARINOS PITTALUGA on 15 February 1922 at Montevideo, certificate No. 35 *** - daughter of Mateo Magarinos Veira and Amanda Pittaluga. Like his sister Ema Sixta, who married the philosopher Jose Pedro Massera, he married into a prominent Montevideo family.

name: Dona Sixta LENGUAS Gonzalez (2nd wife of Candido Juanico)
source: Montevideo civil death registration, 2nd section, act No. 45, 17 Jan 1884 - IMAGE READ; ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-N36Y-D
note: *** THE SISTER OF JUSTINIANA LENGUAS - established 13 September 2026. *** Her death registration of 17 January 1884 names her parents as "Pedro Lenguas, Carmen Gonzalez" and her husband as "Candido Juanico"; the 1846 baptism acts name Justiniana's parents as the same couple. So the second wife of Julia Juanico's father was the sister of Luis Eugenio's mother, and the two families were joined in 1857 - seven years before the marriage this archive has treated as the join. Married Candido Juanico in 1857 per a published genealogy; the mother of Sara, Zara Sista Emirena and Celia Juanico Lenguas, born 1866-1869. She is NOT the mother of Julia, who was born in 1842 to Juliana Joaquina Gonzalez - an inference this archive made from the dates before it could prove it, and then proved. *** THE IMAGE IS NOW READ, 14 September 2026, and it carries the family two generations further back. *** She died at one in the morning at calle de Piedras No. 202, aged 47. Her parents "D. PEDRO LENGUAS y Dona CARMEN GONZALEZ, finados"; her paternal grandparents "D. ANTONIO LENGUAS y Dona JUANA GRANDAL"; her maternal "D. PASCUAL GONZALEZ y Dona JOSEFA GRANDAL". Her husband is recorded "D. CANDIDO JUANICO, Oriental, edad 72 anos, viudo, ABOGADO".
